# @fyit/crouton-auth

> Authentication with Better Auth - teams, billing, passkeys, 2FA

## Components

- `AccountSettingsModal`: Account settings wrapped in a modal, for public page navigation
- `AdminEmailLogs`: Auth email log history with stats, filtering and error details
- `AuthRouteModal`: Login, register and forgot-password forms in a modal overlay
- `CroutonUserPill`: One pill for account and status: member, PIN visitor or signed out
- `TeamCreateForm`: Form to create a new team (organization)
- `TeamDeleteConfirm`: Dialog to confirm deleting a team
- `TeamInvitations`: List of pending team invitations with cancel actions
- `TeamMemberInviteForm`: Form to invite a new member to the team
- `TeamMembers`: List of team members with management actions
- `TeamSettings`: Form to update team settings (name, slug, logo)
- `TeamSwitcher`: Select menu to switch between teams or create a new one

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useAuth`
- `useTeamContext`
